offering_description.value: Distributes electronic components, fasteners and hardware to manufacturers through its Bisco Industries subsidiary. Also provides supply chain services such as kitting and inventory management, and sells value-added items like cable assemblies, enclosures and custom products. Sells through a network of sales offices in North America.

primary_products.value: electronic components; connectors; fasteners; wire and cable; enclosures; switches and relays

primary_services.value: supply chain management; kitting; inventory management programs; custom cable assembly; engineering support

customer_segment.value: B2B: OEM manufacturers, contract manufacturers and industrial users of electronic components and fasteners

end_markets.value: electronics manufacturing; industrial equipment; telecommunications; aerospace and defense; medical devices

revenue_model.value: product sales: electronic components and fasteners sold to manufacturers; service fees: kitting, inventory management and value-added assembly services

value_chain_position.value: distributor: buys components from many suppliers and resells to OEMs and manufacturers

geography_served.value: North America: United States, Canada and Mexico sales offices, plus some international sales including Asia and Europe

specialization.value: related lines: electronic components, fasteners, and related value-added products and services

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: inside sales staff at regional sales offices serving manufacturers; online: website and e-commerce ordering

regulatory_exposure.value: low: normal business rules, some product compliance such as RoHS and export controls

notes: Details on offices and end markets are from general knowledge and may be imprecise.
